title: In a best-case scenario, the ongoing chaos can bring opportunity in next month, says expert | Stock Market News
summary: Indian equity markets face a reality check amid geopolitical tensions, with mid- and small-cap stocks corrected and volatility in metals sector. Despite near-term weakness, long-term opportunities are emerging with moderated valuations and selective buying in strong companies and sectors.
sentiment_reason: The article discusses negative market impacts such as geopolitical tensions, volatile global cues, and sector-specific challenges, but also mentions selective buying and long-term opportunities, indicating a predominantly negative sentiment with some positive aspects.
